findings.mechanism: Baseline save handler retained only global saved.id/saved.revision and unconditionally assigned the response to saved. A delayed POST for workflow A could complete after the user had switched to or created workflow B, making saved.id=A while B was visible; the next B save then sent A's id and A's expected revision and overwrote A. Saves were not serialized per draft and edits made during a save were reported as fully saved.
findings.minimal_reproduction: Baseline source over real local HTTP and ordinary Chromium: rename the draft NEW_A, start a POST /api/workflows and hold its response, click New, rename NEW_B, release A's response, then save B. Baseline B's save adopted A's returned id (independent baseline run: 'B adopted A id'); B's document was not created and A could be overwritten. The current candidate instead returned distinct response ids for A and B, kept both documents under their own ids, and used B's own revision as the CAS base.
findings.expected_behavior: A save must bind the initiating workflow id, revision, document snapshot and edit version; stale responses must not change the active draft's saved identity; only history/listing may refresh; same-draft saves must serialize; edits during a save must remain visibly unsaved; backend immutable revisions and CAS conflicts must remain authoritative.
findings.evidence: reviewer-tests/work/identity-baseline-2/identity-repro-results.json: ST-R04 delayed save A then new B FAIL with 'B adopted A id', plus baseline failures for load-B, reverse-order, dirty-edit, uncommitted-field, same-draft double-click, stale-error, monitor-save and import cases (19/23 baseline failures). reviewer-tests/work/identity-current-final/identity-repro-results.json: ST-R04 cases PASS (23/23 overall). Shipped tests/studio_identity_races.py: 17/17 PASS. Supplied evidence executions.json records baseline_identity exit 1 with 2 failures; my independent baseline harness reproduces the same two primary defects and more.
findings.required_corrections: None outstanding on this candidate; draftGeneration, captured id/revision/snapshot, savesInFlight serialization, guarded history refresh and dirty-state rendering are implemented and independently verified.

findings.mechanism: Baseline poll() fetched the current global runId and rendered whatever snapshot returned, without binding the request to a selection generation or verifying snapshot.id. A delayed snapshot for run A could therefore populate the UI after run B was selected, producing B's header/revision with A's nodes, test counts, rounds, notice and inspector (including A's READY/ACCEPT), and stale failures could clear or degrade B's view.
findings.minimal_reproduction: Baseline source over real local HTTP and ordinary Chromium: hold the /api/runs/A snapshot, select A, select B, release A's held snapshot. Baseline displayed title RUN_A while the revision said Controller run B, with 6 tests and Round 2 ACCEPT from A. Current candidate discarded the stale A response; B remained B and no A content appeared.
findings.expected_behavior: Each snapshot request must bind run_id and a request generation; stale success and failure responses must not touch the current view; the returned snapshot.id must match the requested run; switching runs, leaving the monitor, current failures and timeouts must clear stale nodes/rounds/verdicts; title, nodes, rounds, inspector and history must all come from one verified snapshot; old process records must never show RUNNING.
findings.evidence: reviewer-tests/work/identity-baseline-2/identity-repro-results.json: ST-R05 late A snapshot FAIL with selected B showing RUN_A/6 tests/ACCEPT; reverse, stale-failure, timeout, id-mismatch, A-B-A, isolation and list-failure cases also failed on baseline (19/23 baseline failures). reviewer-tests/work/identity-current-final/identity-repro-results.json: all 23 current cases PASS, including A to B to A with a DB-updated second A, inverse snapshot and list replies, stale and current failures/timeouts, snapshot id mismatch, old process record unconfirmed, draft/monitor isolation and full UI-versus-API provenance. Shipped studio_identity_races.py 17/17 PASS.
findings.required_corrections: None outstanding on this candidate; poll generation binding, snapshot id verification, clear-on-switch/error, cleared run panels and single-snapshot rendering are implemented and independently verified.
